identity.title: Make Shell composition initialization easy to follow

origin.kind: user request and independent junior-readability review
origin.summary: The user asked to continue refactoring and to evaluate each change from a first-time developer perspective.

state.current_summary: PL-0014 is verified: the existing Shell constructor remains the readonly composition owner, named phase markers and an owner map make its order searchable, the source/binding/lifetime contracts are unchanged, focused Debug/Release checks pass, and the first-time-contributor review plus runtime boundaries are recorded.

objective.summary: Expose the existing Shell composition order through named in-constructor phase markers and an owner map without adding a wrapper, interface, manager, or changing ownership or behavior.
constraints: Work only in C:\Git\2D\Dev and preserve the existing dirty worktree.
Do not reopen or split completed PL-0013 partial owners.
Keep OpenVisionShellHostView as the WPF composition owner and preserve field ownership, event order, binding names, callbacks, and Dispose order.
Do not move business policy, persistence, inspection logic, or device ownership into the View.
Do not wait for user input, hardware, or unbounded UI runtime; record those boundaries as unverified.
Run a focused Debug/Release build and Shell lifecycle/readiness contracts after the change.

criteria.text: The constructor contains named phase markers with an explicit order, and the durable owner map names the existing concrete owners and state writers for each phase.
No new abstraction or duplicate owner is introduced, and XAML, command, callback, event subscription, and Dispose contracts remain unchanged.
The affected solution and focused Shell/Recipe readiness checks pass in Debug and Release, with stale direct-owner or old-path searches recorded.
The completion record includes a first-time developer reading route and explicitly states runtime UI/theme/DPI/monitor/hardware boundaries not executed.

evidence.observation: The constructor contains five ordered phase markers for runtime owners, visual wiring, Workspace/Recipe, commands/session/layer/test adapters, and event/release callbacks; the durable map names the existing call path and owners.
Constructor body token contract passed with 22534 tokens before and after comments-only editing; no assignment, callback, event, or Dispose order changed.
OpenVisionLab.sln Debug and Release builds completed with 0 warnings and 0 errors.
ShellRecipeBasicLifecycleViewContract passed 7/7 in Debug and Release; OpenVisionReadinessCheck passed in Debug and Release.
RefactorAudit returned REFACTOR_AUDIT=PASS, DocumentationIndex returned PASS, and git diff --check returned exit code 0; only existing line-ending conversion warnings were emitted by Git.

Independent junior-readability review recommends accepting the change: the five-phase constructor route is easier to search, while the large constructor and controller tracing remain explicit residual costs. Runtime UI, theme, DPI, monitor, hardware, native hang, and long-run shutdown boundaries remain unverified.

events.summary: Keep readonly field assignments in the constructor. Do not add a Shell composition wrapper or remove readonly guarantees merely to create helper methods; make the existing sequence navigable with named phase comments and an explicit owner map.
All PL-0014 criteria are evidenced. The source-only navigation change is accepted without reopening or splitting the completed Shell owners.
